Name: MultiSleep
Author: ThatKaito
Description:
[size=4][b]MultiSleep[/b][/size]

This mod allows you to sleep many days at a time.

You can select from multiple modes

- Specific number of days
- Sleep Until...
  - Rain
  - Storm
  - Great Luck
  - Festival
  - Birthday
  - Traveling Cart Day
  - Bookseller
  - Any crop is ready
  - All crops are ready
  - End of the month (wake up on the 28th)

[size=4][b]How it Works[/b][/size]

When MultiSleeping, you will simply automatically go back to sleep as soon as the day begins. This means that daily processes will still happen, for example crop growth, sprinklers usage, hoppers, the mod [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1063]Automate[/url], etc. Processes that cannot happen instantly, will not have time to complete. For example, your animals will [b]not[/b] have time to find and reach grass during that day, but they [b]will[/b] eat hay if it is available.

From the config file, you can set a price per day on the MultiSleeping, for balance. The default value is zero, because this is intended as a Quality of Life mod.
If you run out of money while sleeping, the MultiSleep is stopped and you will wake up even if the chosen condition is not met yet.

If you sleep a specific number of days, the interface will show you if you can't afford the number of days you are requesting. For the other types, since they are dynamic, you do not get warned in advance.

[size=4][b]Other notes[/b][/size]

- If sleeping until rain, a storm or a green rain will qualify.
- If sleeping until great luck, the fortune teller threshold is used.
- If sleeping until a festival, a locked festival like the Desert festival will not qualify until it is unlocked.
- If sleeping until a birthday, all the NPCs that currently exist will be counted. This includes modded NPCs, and NPCs you have not met yet.
- If sleeping until Any/All Crops are ready, only crops that can be expected to grow will count, to avoid infinite sleep. This excludes forageables, dead crops, and crops that are growing in an area without rain and are not currently watered. This includes garden pots, powdermelons in winter, and greenhouse crops. If you have proper sprinkler coverage or retaining soil, then the crops will stay watered, and keep being counted. Outside crops in non-winter weather will always count, and if they are not well sprinklered, your coma might last a very very long time, waiting for rain to finish growing your crops.
- If sleeping until the end of the month, you will wake up on the 28th, allowing you to prepare anything you might need for the upcoming season change. 

[size=4][b]Origins[/b][/size]

This feature was originally designed and programmed as part of the mod [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/16087]Archipelago[/url], which is another mod of mine. People liked it so much, that I'm now extracting it to a standalone mod. If Archipelago is installed, this mod will simply do nothing, because Archipelago has special, server-based ways to dictate the behavior of MultiSleep features.

[size=4][b]Multiplayer[/b][/size]

This mod has not been tested for Multiplayer usage. My guess is that only the host can control the sleeps, but I don't actually know.
